candidate_relations.reason: The cardiac MRI explicitly demonstrates late gadolinium enhancement in the basal inferior, midcavity inferior, and inferoseptal myocardium of the left ventricle in addition to RV free wall and RVOT involvement, satisfying criteria for biventricular arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. The candidate correctly identifies the arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy family and RV component but restricts scope to right ventricular involvement, missing the required biventricular designation that is central to the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies ARVC/right ventricular involvement only; omits the confirmed biventricular (left ventricular) involvement documented on cardiac MRI

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis uses updated 'Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy (AC)' nomenclature reflecting 2019 Padua criteria, which encompasses biventricular and left-dominant variants beyond classic ARVC; candidate uses older ARVC terminology and omits LV involvement
